comment:
* Wraps a byte array, providing a set of methods for parsing data from it. Numerical values are
 * parsed with the assumption that their constituent bytes are in big endian order.

variables.name: limit
variables.comment: TODO(internal b/147657250): Enforce this limit on all read methods.

methods.name: public void reset(int limit)
methods.comment:
* Resets the position to zero and the limit to the specified value. This might replace or wipe
   * the {@link #getData() underlying array}, potentially invalidating any local references.
   *
   * @param limit The limit to set.

methods.name: public void reset(byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Updates the instance to wrap {@code data}, and resets the position to zero and the limit to
   * {@code data.length}.
   *
   * @param data The array to wrap.

methods.name: public void reset(byte[] data, int limit)
methods.comment:
* Updates the instance to wrap {@code data}, and resets the position to zero.
   *
   * @param data The array to wrap.
   * @param limit The limit to set.

methods.name: public void ensureCapacity(int requiredCapacity)
methods.comment:
* Ensures the backing array is at least {@code requiredCapacity} long. * *

{@link #getPosition() position}, {@link #limit() limit}, and all data in the underlying * array (including that beyond {@link #limit()}) are preserved. * *

This might replace or wipe the {@link #getData() underlying array}, potentially invalidating * any local references.

methods.name: public int bytesLeft()
methods.comment: Returns the number of bytes yet to be read.

methods.name: public int limit()
methods.comment: Returns the limit.

methods.name: public void setLimit(int limit)
methods.comment:
* Sets the limit.
   *
   * @param limit The limit to set.

methods.name: public int getPosition()
methods.comment: Returns the current offset in the array, in bytes.

methods.name: public void setPosition(int position)
methods.comment:
* Sets the reading offset in the array.
   *
   * @param position Byte offset in the array from which to read.
   * @throws IllegalArgumentException Thrown if the new position is neither in nor at the end of the
   *     array.

methods.name: public byte[] getData()
methods.comment:
* Returns the underlying array. * *

Changes to this array are reflected in the results of the {@code read...()} methods. * *

This reference must be assumed to become invalid when {@link #reset} or {@link * #ensureCapacity} are called (because the array might get reallocated).

methods.name: public int capacity()
methods.comment: Returns the capacity of the array, which may be larger than the limit.

methods.name: public void skipBytes(int bytes)
methods.comment:
* Moves the reading offset by {@code bytes}.
   *
   * @param bytes The number of bytes to skip.
   * @throws IllegalArgumentException Thrown if the new position is neither in nor at the end of the
   *     array.

methods.name: public void readBytes(ParsableBitArray bitArray, int length)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes into {@code bitArray}, and resets the position of {@code
   * bitArray} to zero.
   *
   * @param bitArray The {@link ParsableBitArray} into which the bytes should be read.
   * @param length The number of bytes to write.

methods.name: public void readBytes(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes into {@code buffer} at {@code offset}.
   *
   * @see System#arraycopy(Object, int, Object, int, int)
   * @param buffer The array into which the read data should be written.
   * @param offset The offset in {@code buffer} at which the read data should be written.
   * @param length The number of bytes to read.

methods.name: public void readBytes(ByteBuffer buffer, int length)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes into {@code buffer}.
   *
   * @see ByteBuffer#put(byte[], int, int)
   * @param buffer The {@link ByteBuffer} into which the read data should be written.
   * @param length The number of bytes to read.

methods.name: public int peekUnsignedByte()
methods.comment: Peeks at the next byte as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public char peekChar()
methods.comment: Peeks at the next char.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedByte()
methods.comment: Reads the next byte as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedShort()
methods.comment: Reads the next two bytes as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public int readLittleEndianUnsignedShort()
methods.comment: Reads the next two bytes as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public short readShort()
methods.comment: Reads the next two bytes as a signed value.

methods.name: public short readLittleEndianShort()
methods.comment: Reads the next two bytes as a signed value.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedInt24()
methods.comment: Reads the next three bytes as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public int readInt24()
methods.comment: Reads the next three bytes as a signed value.

methods.name: public int readLittleEndianInt24()
methods.comment: Reads the next three bytes as a signed value in little endian order.

methods.name: public int readLittleEndianUnsignedInt24()
methods.comment: Reads the next three bytes as an unsigned value in little endian order.

methods.name: public long readUnsignedInt()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes as an unsigned value.

methods.name: public long readLittleEndianUnsignedInt()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes as an unsigned value in little endian order.

methods.name: public int readInt()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes as a signed value

methods.name: public int readLittleEndianInt()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes as a signed value in little endian order.

methods.name: public long readLong()
methods.comment: Reads the next eight bytes as a signed value.

methods.name: public long readLittleEndianLong()
methods.comment: Reads the next eight bytes as a signed value in little endian order.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedFixedPoint1616()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes, returning the integer portion of the fixed point 16.16 integer.

methods.name: public int readSynchSafeInt()
methods.comment:
* Reads a Synchsafe integer. * *

Synchsafe integers keep the highest bit of every byte zeroed. A 32 bit synchsafe integer can * store 28 bits of information. * * @return The parsed value.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedIntToInt()
methods.comment:
* Reads the next four bytes as an unsigned integer into an integer, if the top bit is a zero.
   *
   * @throws IllegalStateException Thrown if the top bit of the input data is set.

methods.name: public int readLittleEndianUnsignedIntToInt()
methods.comment:
* Reads the next four bytes as a little endian unsigned integer into an integer, if the top bit
   * is a zero.
   *
   * @throws IllegalStateException Thrown if the top bit of the input data is set.

methods.name: public long readUnsignedLongToLong()
methods.comment:
* Reads the next eight bytes as an unsigned long into a long, if the top bit is a zero.
   *
   * @throws IllegalStateException Thrown if the top bit of the input data is set.

methods.name: public float readFloat()
methods.comment: Reads the next four bytes as a 32-bit floating point value.

methods.name: public double readDouble()
methods.comment: Reads the next eight bytes as a 64-bit floating point value.

methods.name: public String readString(int length)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes as UTF-8 characters.
   *
   * @param length The number of bytes to read.
   * @return The string encoded by the bytes.

methods.name: public String readString(int length, Charset charset)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes as characters in the specified {@link Charset}.
   *
   * @param length The number of bytes to read.
   * @param charset The character set of the encoded characters.
   * @return The string encoded by the bytes in the specified character set.

methods.name: public String readNullTerminatedString(int length)
methods.comment:
* Reads the next {@code length} bytes as UTF-8 characters. A terminating NUL byte is discarded,
   * if present.
   *
   * @param length The number of bytes to read.
   * @return The string, not including any terminating NUL byte.

methods.name: public String readNullTerminatedString()
methods.comment:
* Reads up to the next NUL byte (or the limit) as UTF-8 characters.
   *
   * @return The string not including any terminating NUL byte, or null if the end of the data has
   *     already been reached.

methods.name: public String readDelimiterTerminatedString(char delimiter)
methods.comment:
* Reads up to the next delimiter byte (or the limit) as UTF-8 characters.
   *
   * @return The string not including any terminating delimiter byte, or null if the end of the data
   *     has already been reached.

methods.name: public String readLine()
methods.comment:
* Reads a line of text. * *

A line is considered to be terminated by any one of a carriage return ('\r'), a line feed * ('\n'), or a carriage return followed immediately by a line feed ('\r\n'). The UTF-8 charset is * used. This method discards leading UTF-8 byte order marks, if present. * * @return The line not including any line-termination characters, or null if the end of the data * has already been reached.

methods.name: public long readUtf8EncodedLong()
methods.comment:
* Reads a long value encoded by UTF-8 encoding
   *
   * @throws NumberFormatException if there is a problem with decoding
   * @return Decoded long value

methodNames: public void reset(byte[] data, int limit)
public void readBytes(ParsableBitArray bitArray, int length)
public void readBytes(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length)
public void readBytes(ByteBuffer buffer, int length)
public String readString(int length, Charset charset)
